overview.title: Overview
overview.p1: NoirPad is a note-taking app with a hacker/terminal aesthetic: neon text on a dark background (17 themes), a monospace editor font and ASCII effects.
overview.p2: It supports a tree of folders and notes, encryption, export, tags, themes and more.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.focus: Sidebar / focus mode (in Markdown mode: bold)
keys.clearFormatting: Clear formatting of the selection (colour, background, font, size)
keys.linkOpen: Open a link in the note

commands.title: Command bar
commands.intro: Open the command bar with Ctrl+Shift+P. Type a command starting with a colon.
commands.encrypt: Lock the note with a password

notes.title: Notes and folders
notes.tree: Tree of folders and notes in the left panel
notes.drag: Drag items to move them (drag & drop)
notes.contextMenu: Right-click to open the context menu
notes.delete: Delete removes it (moves it to the trash)

editor.title: Editor
editor.monospace: Each note is either rich text (formatting) or Markdown (Ctrl+M)

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.intro: A note can be locked with its own password (Lock button, Ctrl+Shift+L or :encrypt). The text is encrypted with Fernet (AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256); the key is derived from the password with PBKDF2-SHA256 (480,000 iterations, random salt). Locked notes show a lock icon.
encryption.decrypt: :decrypt removes the encryption for good (the note is saved as plain text again)
encryption.password: The password is never stored — if you forget it, the note cannot be recovered
encryption.notEncrypted: Not encrypted: the note's title, tags and images

images.title: Images
images.paste: Paste an image from the clipboard with Ctrl+V
images.folder: Images are stored as files in the images folder of the data directory (%LOCALAPPDATA%\NoirPad\images)
images.viewer: Click an image to view it full size

export.title: Export
export.pdf: :exportpdf — Export as PDF via the print dialog (Markdown notes: preview or source text)
export.all: Settings → Data — export all notes as Markdown or HTML files in a ZIP

tags.title: Tags and favorites
tags.tag: :tag <name> — Add a tag to the note (remove it with × on the tag)
tags.fav: :fav or Ctrl+D — Add the note to favorites, or remove it
tags.sorting: Favorites are sorted to the top of the list

themes.title: Themes
themes.intro: 17 color themes. Change the theme in Settings or with :theme <name>.

backup.title: Backup
backup.backup: :backup — Download all notes and images as a .zip file
backup.import: :import — Restore a backup from a .zip file (replaces all notes; a safety copy is made first)

effects.title: Effects
effects.matrix: :matrix — Turn the Matrix rain animation on/off
effects.splash: Splash screen with an ASCII art logo on startup

md.title: Markdown
md.intro: NoirPad supports Markdown formatting. Toggle Markdown mode using the MD button in the top bar (or Ctrl+M). Click any example below to copy it to clipboard.
md.tipBacktick: Tip: Backtick (`) on Czech keyboard = AltGr + ý + space
md.tipImages: Tip: Use +Img button or Ctrl+V to paste images directly. Click any image to view fullscreen, Ctrl+wheel to resize.
